title: The Circuit Teacher
logline: An itinerant scholar travels between neglected fringe colonies teaching children navigation and literature, until a regional education trust orders them arrested for unlicensed instruction.

roles.description: A gentle, stubborn educator who has spent forty years teaching kids on ore barges.
A zealous regional regulator determined to enforce state curriculum monopolies.
A fast enforcement cutter tasked with tracking unauthorized civilian schools.
A hollowed-out cargo module converted into a makeshift school for miner children.
The imposing stone-clad administrative headquarters of the regional education trust.
The monolithic corporate trust holding exclusive charter rights to all accredited education.

public_situation: Station lounges across three systems buzz with news of an arrest warrant issued for an unlicensed tutor serving remote mining outposts.
private_truth: The education trust's mandatory standardized curriculum deliberately excludes orbital mechanics so belt children can never pass commercial pilot certification.

beats.public_change: Enforcement notices appear at gate lounges demanding the surrender of an unlicensed school ship.

missions.reason: The teacher needs an independent pilot to collect handwritten primer textbooks from a hidden depot before inspectors impound the module.
missions.private_fact: The textbooks contain handwritten astronomical tables that allow students to calculate independent gate jump trajectories.

beats.public_change: The teacher flees to a neighboring mining belt, where families gather supplies to sustain the hidden classroom.

missions.reason: The teacher hires the pilot to buy and deliver basic student rations and paper stylus packs to the new asteroid anchorage.
missions.private_fact: Three of the teacher's former students are now navigators on commercial freighters flying under forged credentials.

beats.public_change: The trust inspector's cutter intercepts communications in the neighboring belt, cornering the classroom module.

missions.reason: The teacher asks the pilot to draw the cutter's fire so the children's module can decouple and hide in the belt debris.
missions.private_fact: The inspector hails the pilot offering an official navigation voucher and fuel permits to stand aside and transmit the classroom coordinates.

beats.public_change: The inspector tracks the teacher to the regional capital where the trust's governing board is holding its annual convocation.

missions.reason: The teacher asks the pilot to deliver their complete forty-year teaching archive directly to the trust's public audit desk.
missions.private_fact: The archive contains comparative test scores proving fringe children taught by the teacher scored higher than the trust's private academies.

player_choice.prompt: The board offers the pilot three paths to settle the unlicensed instruction dispute.

options.label: Present the comparative scores and compel official charter status for the fringe classes
Broker an honourable retirement pension for the teacher on the condition they cease teaching
Hand over the names of the teacher's unlicensed navigators for a trust reward

beats.public_change: News of the board's decision reaches the mining habitats as families await the final outcome.

missions.reason: The teacher needs the finalized legal charter papers carried back to the waiting families at the asteroid belt.
missions.private_fact: The teacher is preparing to train a new generation of apprentice instructors to continue the circuit.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the archive, cripples the cutter, and returns the charter papers.
resolutions.summary: The trust grants independent charters to fringe schools, allowing miner children to legally qualify for pilot licences.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot carried an old tutor's primers across three systems and broke a trust's monopoly on flight teaching.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot brokers an honourable retirement pension.
resolutions.summary: {role:wandering_teacher} retires to an inner-system garden station while remote mining outposts lose their only teacher.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the inspector's bounty or turns over the student roster.
resolutions.summary: Enforcers impound the classroom module, arresting the navigator graduates and tightening trust control across the sector.

consequences.public_summary: Word spread that a pilot turned over an old teacher's student roster to corporate auditors.

resolutions.reached_by: The teacher is captured when the pilot fails or abandons jobs.
resolutions.summary: Enforcement cutters seize the itinerant tutor, dissolving the mobile classes and restoring state educational control.

loose_threads.detail: Educational trust bond yields climbed steadily in three systems right before the tutor's arrest warrant was published.
The inspector's enforcement cutter bore an automated charter registration that lapsed twelve months ago.

radio_hooks: Regional Education Trust seeks information on itinerant tutor operating without license.
Mining families in {system} petition for recognition of local mobile classroom charters.

voice_direction.wandering_teacher: Slow, grandfatherly cadences, pauses to let listener process thoughts. Never sounds bitter.
voice_direction.trust_inspector: Sharp, clipped, cites legal codes by number and refuses to answer questions outside protocol.
